title: Best AI UGC Ads Tools for Small Agencies (2026)

tools.name: Wireflow
tools.modelSupport: Multi-model catalog across image, video and audio nodes

quickstart.label: Add the hosted MCP server to Claude Code, then approve the OAuth consent screen:
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http wireflow https://www.wireflow.ai/api/mcp

quickstart.label: In Claude Desktop or claude.ai, add the same URL as a custom connector. Read-only tools (`list_workflows`, `list_models`, `get_execution`) cost nothing; `run_workflow` is the only one that spends credits.

tools.name: Arcads
tools.tagline: · script-to-actor generator with a large AI actor roster
tools.note: Checked 2026-09-01: Arcads advertises an "AI Video API" and "Lip Sync API" on its own site, but publishes no public developer docs and no public pricing page we could reach — pricing is behind the app.

tools.name: Creatify
tools.modelSupport: Creatify’s own avatar and URL-to-video models
tools.note: Creatify’s docs describe generating videos "programmatically" through "simple REST API calls". Its homepage advertises "no credit card required" to start, which is a trial claim rather than a stated free tier.

tools.name: MakeUGC
tools.tagline: · credit-metered avatar generator with a separate API plan
tools.note: MakeUGC links "API access" to app.makeugc.ai/api/platform/documentation from its own footer. Its entry offer is a paid $1 trial, not a free tier.

tools.name: HeyGen
tools.tagline: · avatar and lip-sync platform with heavy localization
tools.modelSupport: HeyGen’s avatar, voice and translation models
tools.note: Verified 2026-09-01 from HeyGen’s own quickstart: the API base URL is https://api.heygen.com and it authenticates with an `X-Api-Key` header. No official SDK package is referenced, so no install command is reproduced here.

tools.name: Captions
tools.tagline: · mobile-first editor with a cloned-likeness AI Twin
tools.modelSupport: Captions’ own captioning and video generation models
tools.note: Checked 2026-09-01: the API is documented under the Mirage brand and help.mirage.app now redirects to captions.ai/help. No verbatim request example was published on the overview page, so none is reproduced here.
